entities.name: Helana
entities.description: Sun worshipper whose journey to Hell to rescue her father left her half-dark and forced her to give up her priesthood.

entities.name: Gohrah
aliases: goddess of the dark half of the Moon
entities.description: Goddess of the dark half of the Moon.

entities.name: Koborah
entities.description: Sun priest and Helana's father, summoned by Gerheart and rescued from Hell.

entities.name: Gerheart
entities.description: Planeswalker who was about to summon Koborah.

entities.name: Illith
entities.description: Demon who told Helana her father was in Hell and guided her there; offers future service.

entities.name: Archduke
aliases: Archduke of that part of Hell
entities.description: Ruler of that part of Hell, killed when his spell misfired.

events.summary: Koborah was whisked away by Gerheart's summoning before teaching Helana all the Sun-stones' uses.
Helana and Illith tricked the Archduke's servants into releasing Koborah, and she returned with him and Rorsa; the Archduke's misfired spell killed him.
events.quote: she and Illith tricked the servants of the Archduke

events.summary: Helana gave up her priesthood, half-dark from the influence of Gohrah.
events.quote: She had to give up her priesthood

relations.quote: Helana's father, the Sun priest named Koborah
Illith told her that her father had been taken down to Hell
